name: How do plumbers find the source of a sewer gas leak?

mainEntity.name: How do plumbers find the source of a sewer gas leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbers use several methods to pinpoint sewer gas leaks. They often start with a visual inspection of visible plumbing fixtures and vents. Smoke testing is a common technique where non-toxic smoke is introduced into the sewer system; smoke escaping from a crack or break indicates the leak's location. They might also use video camera inspections for sewer lines or perform pressure tests on drainage systems to identify issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbers use visual inspections, smoke testing, and video camera inspections to accurately locate the source of sewer gas leaks.
